author: Xephur
quote:
I honestly do not know what they were thinking with the narrative direction.
I am so disappointed that I gave them my $80.

This is not GTA, it's postmodernist ideology wearing the skinsuit of GTA. I do not know who this game was made for, but it sure as hell isn't me.

I genuinely can't express my hatred for the writers and all of the people who greenlit these awful characters and the obsession with the main character's relationship to a terrible woman; a genuinely awful person.

You're supposed to like characters in a game to enjoy it. I actively hate the characters and I hate the people at Rockstar for basically bowing to the zeitgeist and destroying a franchise.

It's going to do well, but not because of the merits of the game itself.... because of the name.

Don't waste your money, there are SO many more worthwhile games out there; ones that don't preach at you like a pastor.
